primary_study_registration_clauses: This was a first-in-human, phase I, nonrandomized, open-label, multiple-dose, two-part study conducted at six sites in Japan and eight in the United States (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT02564900; ClinicalTrials.jp 152978).
primary_permitted_assay_methods_only: Patient HER2 status at enrollment was defined on the basis of local laboratory testing data.
A retrospective analysis of HER2 IHC and ISH of archived formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded tumor tissue sections was done after enrollment by a central laboratory (HercepTest, Dako).

The response-evaluable set includes all patients with HER2-expressing non-breast/non-gastric solid tumors or HER2-mutant solid tumors who received at least one dose of T-DXd, and baseline measurable tumors assessed by independent central review.
